summary: Obfuscated preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled Math_Symbol.js payload
details: @cacheable/utils@2.5.1 ships an obfuscated preinstall script (setup.mjs) that uses an obfuscator.io-style rotated string array with an RC4-based per-string decoder to hide all literals, including the download URL and command arguments. On npm install, the script downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary, and uses it to execute a sibling file Math_Symbol.js — a 727 KB opaque Bun-CJS bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') that is not referenced by the package's Node main entry and has no relation to the advertised 'caching utilities' purpose. The alternate-runtime execution deliberately bypasses Node-based scanners: the payload's actual behavior only runs under the freshly downloaded Bun binary. Installing this package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
